adv.advParallelHint: Tasks of this project {0} run one at a time by default (so two agents never edit the same git work tree at once). Raise it to let N tasks run in the same directory concurrently.
adv.advParallelWarn: 🔴 Only suitable for projects that barely write to the working directory (patrol / research / Q&A). Projects that write files or run {0} will hit {1} conflicts and same-name files overwriting each other. Effective parallelism = min(global limit, this value, account limit).
adv.advTimeoutHint: How long a single task may run. {0} (Settings → "Task timeout", default 30 minutes). On expiry it takes the same "pause" path: interrupts the current round but keeps context, resumable.
adv.advTimeoutWarn: 🔴 Cost of raising it: {0} is a non-terminal state, and the cron re-dispatch gate counts non-terminal tasks as in flight — tasks stuck past timeout block later triggers longer. Does not affect already-running tasks (they pick up the new value on next start/resume).
adv.advPortsHint: Ports occupied by this project (comma-separated, max 5). Must fall inside the admin-configured {0} and must not collide with other projects. Out-of-pool or colliding saves return 409 with conflict details. {1}.
adv.advWikiExtHint: The wiki only reads {0} by default. Add extensions here (space or comma separated) to browse agent-produced json / csv files in the wiki. Saving empty = back to default (only .md).
adv.advWikiExtWarn: Lowercase letters and digits only, max {max}; hidden files ({0} etc., starting with a dot) and secret-type extensions are never readable. Non-.md files are capped at 1 MiB.
adv.advRunnersHint: Send whitelisted Bash commands of this project to a runner daemon on the target machine (e.g. {0} must run on the mac). Each entry = one runner + one purpose + a path mapping (the runner's physical path, which differs from the platform WSL /home/user/...) + a command whitelist (one per line, .* after R3 escaping).
adv.advRunnersWarn: 🔴 runner_id must actually be registered in /runners; a wrong {0} makes exec fail for sure; overly broad regexes like {1} send nearly all Bash to the runner — be careful. Empty = clear (back to NULL, everything runs local SDK bash, no remote).
adv.errExtWildcard: Wildcards `*` (allow-all) are not allowed — list extensions one by one
adv.errExtInvalid: Invalid extension {raw}: only lowercase letters and digits, 1-16 chars
adv.errExtDenied: Extension {ext} is a secret/credential type and cannot be exposed to the wiki
adv.errPickPatterns: Add at least one command pattern
adv.errParallelRange: Parallel limit must be an integer 1-{max}
adv.errTimeoutRange: Timeout must be an integer ({min}-{max} minutes); empty = inherit global
adv.errPortInvalid: Invalid port "{p}": must be an integer 1024-65535
